info.title: Beans News API & MCP
info.description: Read-only API for publisher Articles, Sources, related Articles, and external Article mentions. Collections return data, pagination, and meta.

tags.name: Articles
tags.description: Publisher Article search, retrieval, related reading, and monitoring.

tags.name: Sources
tags.description: Publisher metadata keyed by Source UUID.

tags.name: MCP
tags.description: Model Context Protocol access for AI-agent clients.

q.name: q
q.description: Optional relevance query. On Sources and label routes, a case-insensitive prefix query.

score_threshold.name: score_threshold
score_threshold.description: Optional relevance threshold. Used only with q.

content_type.name: content_type
content_type.description: One stored Article type. Omit to include every stored type.

authors.name: authors
authors.description: Author text filters. Every supplied value must match (CSV).

tags.name: tags
tags.description: Normalized tag terms. Every supplied term must match (CSV).

from.name: from
from.description: UTC lower timestamp bound. YYYY-MM-DD means 00:00:00Z.

to.name: to
to.description: UTC upper timestamp bound. YYYY-MM-DD means 00:00:00Z.

min_article_count.name: min_article_count
min_article_count.description: Minimum number of Articles in a Story.

content.description: Present only with full_content=true when available.

story_id.description: Stable Story UUID. Present when the Article belongs to a Story.

articles.description: Service-relative member-Article path. For the public gateway, request /beans plus this path.

get.description: Returns status alive when the service is reachable.
Lists category values accepted by the categories Article filter.
Lists entity values accepted by the entities Article filter.
Lists region values accepted by the regions Article filter.
Returns news Articles from the recent 24-hour publication and attention window, ordered by attention. It does not accept content_type or date bounds.
Returns Articles ordered newest first. This route does not accept date bounds.
Returns attention-ranked Articles with trend metrics when available. This route does not accept date bounds.
Returns Articles matching an optional relevance query, exact Article IDs or URLs, and filters. Without q, results are newest first.
Returns publisher Sources. q matches the beginning of Source metadata; domains narrows results.

post.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint for the Beans service. Exposes Beans tools to MCP-compatible clients such as AI agents and LLM-powered applications.

get.description: Returns one Article selected by UUID. Set full_content=true to request content when available.
Returns related Articles for a selected Article UUID, ordered newest first. It is not a relevance-ranked search route.
Returns external platform or forum observations for the selected Article UUID, ordered by observation time.
Returns one publisher Source selected by UUID.
Lists sentiment values accepted by the sentiments Article filter.
Returns Stories identified by stable UUIDs. The collection does not include every member Article.
Returns one Story selected by its stable UUID, including a service-relative member-Article path. For the public gateway, request /beans plus links.articles.
Returns member Articles for a stable Story UUID. Article filters narrow the returned members.
